title: Wire hooks into all services
description: Add hook trigger points throughout specialist-pool, task-loop, checkpoint, and abandonment services. Emit events at specialist_start/complete/failed, gate_passed/failed, escalation, pre/post_merge, etc.
acceptance_criteria: Hook triggers at 10+ event points across services
Context variables passed to each hook
Blocking hooks respected at merge and phase gate points
Non-blocking hooks at status and notification points
